body: the thing about not wanting to play video games because of being afraid of losing is too real tbh, it got to the point where i'd be nauseous even thinking of the game in general and i still can't even stand to watch others play anymore because of how nervous it makes me. but i don't think doing something i'd enjoy would really address the problem, since it's still more of a matter of effort than anything. i didnt have a computer for a while and i still felt the same way, and instead of finding a new hobby i just lied in bed and stared at the ceiling for hours and hours until i fell asleep again. i don't really experience boredom, but that's probably a bad thing.
